writer_gaps.note: Age intervals are varied mainly in P-lineage samples; most samples have one L1 window.
Neuron populations and age intervals are not fully crossed; age series only for P lineage.
21-24 hph samples are titled L1 but age field says L1/L2.
Each scRNA-seq library pools many synchronized worms; no individual donors.
FACS neuron-subset labels are not standard tissue or cell-type ontology terms.
16 experiments/libraries may carry batch effects; not modeled in labels.
Age is recorded as hours post hatch (hph), a time from hatching.
All samples are hermaphrodite and wt; most are L1 stage.
